content: OpenRouter tool routing: best-effort route to tool-capable providers; provider.require_parameters=true hard-filters providers that ignore params; tools/response_format soft preference; Auto Exacto tiers providers by tool-call quality; errors 400/401/402 credits/403 moderation/408/429/502/503 no provider; errors may arrive with HTTP 200 in body; finish_reason error + native_finish_reason.
